description: Test presence or absence of /run before the container's init is started
name: dist-config-nonsystemd-rundir

alpine-latest.description:
Test that containers with alpine-latest have /run pre-mounted
before the init is started as configured
in osctld/configs/lxc/alpine/common.conf.
alpine-latest.script:
machine.wait_for_osctl_pool("tank")
  machine.wait_until_online

  testct = get_container_id

  machine.succeeds(
    "osctl ct new --distribution alpine --version latest #{testct}",
  )
  run_script_path = "/tmp/#{testct}-test-script.sh"

  machine.push_file("/nix/store/qq9k967gim0jpkvmya3nf7drjlsmr5q1-dist-config-nonsystemd-rundir-script.sh", run_script_path)
  machine.succeeds("osctl ct runscript -r #{testct} #{run_script_path}")
  machine.all_succeed(
  "osctl ct del -f --prune #{testct}",
  "osctl repository images prune"
)
